/* EaseGraph — bridge to Premiere (CEP evalScript) with a built-in demo host */
(function (root) {
  'use strict';
  var TPS = 254016000000;
  var cep = root.__adobe_cep__;

  function callPremiere(fn, arg) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var script = 'FrameshiftEG.' + fn + '(' + (arg === undefined ? '' : JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(arg))) + ')';
      cep.evalScript(script, function (res) {
        if (res === 'EvalScript error.' || res == null) {
          return reject(new Error('Premiere script error. Is the host script loaded?'));
        }
        var out;
        try { out = JSON.parse(res); } catch (e) { return reject(new Error('Bad reply: ' + res)); }
        if (out.ok) resolve(out.data); else reject(new Error(out.error));
      });
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Demo host (runs in a normal browser for testing) ---------- */
  var fps = 25, tb = TPS / fps;
  var demo = {
    seqId: 'demo-seq', timebase: tb, frameW: 1920, frameH: 1080, playhead: Math.round(tb * 10),
    clips: [{
      nodeId: 'demo-1', name: 'Title.png', start: 0, end: 4 * TPS, inPoint: 0,
      params: [
        { c: 1, p: 0, comp: 'Motion', name: 'Position', keys: [{ t: 0, v: [0.2, 0.5] }, { t: TPS, v: [0.8, 0.5] }] }
      ]
    }]
  };
  function findDemo(nodeId, c, p) {
    var clip = demo.clips.filter(function (x) { return x.nodeId === nodeId; })[0];
    return clip && clip.params.filter(function (x) { return x.c === c && x.p === p; })[0];
  }
  function demoValueAt(prm, t) {
    var k = prm.keys;
    if (t <= k[0].t) return k[0].v;
    for (var i = 0; i < k.length - 1; i++) {
      if (t >= k[i].t && t <= k[i + 1].t) {
        var r = (t - k[i].t) / (k[i + 1].t - k[i].t);
        return root.Ease.lerpVal(k[i].v, k[i + 1].v, r);
      }
    }
    return k[k.length - 1].v;
  }
  var demoHost = {
    getSelection: function () { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(demo)); },
    writeRanges: function (spec) {
      spec.jobs.forEach(function (job) {
        var prm = findDemo(job.nodeId, job.c, job.p), tol = job.tol || 1;
        prm.keys = prm.keys.filter(function (k) {
          if (k.t < job.t0 - tol || k.t > job.t1 + tol) return true;
          return job.keys.some(function (w) { return Math.abs(w.t - k.t) <= tol; });
        });
        job.keys.forEach(function (w) {
          var ex = prm.keys.filter(function (k) { return Math.abs(k.t - w.t) <= tol; })[0];
          if (ex) ex.v = w.v; else prm.keys.push({ t: w.t, v: w.v });
        });
        prm.keys.sort(function (a, b) { return a.t - b.t; });
      });
      return { written: 1 };
    },
    valueAt: function (a) { return { v: demoValueAt(findDemo(a.nodeId, a.c, a.p), a.t) }; },
    selSignature: function () {
      return demo.clips.map(function (c) { return c.nodeId + c.params.map(function (p) { return p.keys.length; }).join(','); }).join('|');
    },
    ping: function () { return { app: 'Demo', version: '0' }; }
  };

  root.Host = {
    isPremiere: !!cep,
    call: function (fn, arg) {
      if (cep) return callPremiere(fn, arg);
      return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
        try { res(demoHost[fn](arg)); } catch (e) { rej(e); }
      });
    },
    setDemoPlayhead: function (t) { demo.playhead = t; },
    _demo: demo
  };
})(window);
